raw_response:
Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates complete opacification of the left hemithorax with a marked mediastinal shift to the left and compensatory hyperinflation of the right lung, which are classic findings for left lung agenesis. The absence of any visible left lung parenchyma distinguishes this from hypoplasia, where some lung tissue would typically be present.
